scope: Design only. No Git edits, ROS publishers, IPC, signals, simulator or training. Native V9 failed reset not repaired or retried by this review.

minimal_protocol.control_scope: Only stepped adapter. Nonstepped behavior retains existing timer behavior. Exactly three robots and all existing safety/source-age gates unchanged.

fields.actual_driver_ack: Unchanged mr3-drive-target-consumed-v1, exact epoch/clock/decisionseq/values for all three; actual storage only.

takeover: Pause and align physical clock T0 using existing real warmup ticks. Guard has already produced timer result for T0; do not recompute it.

Each controlled participant callback switches timer off logically and ACKs. SingleThreadedExecutor serializes prior callbacks; later queued timer callbacks must return without publication. Guard takeover confirms last normal T0 status/seq and freezes timer.
Require existing before-release zero target for each robot stored by actual drivers at T0. This does not require ready=true and never permits nonzero startup motion.
Advance exactly20 physical ticks to uncommitted T1 only after this actual zero storage.
each_new_clock: At paused exact new clock T, worker sends unique state request and waits bounded wall time without advancing physics.

Information waits for all eligible causal local odom and map->odom TF within old .5s gate; future input is retained, never projected back; publishes one real state bundle and existing side topics, then ACK references exact sequence/SHA/raw sources.
Peer waits until it actually receives matching bundle and all exact side topic bytes; publishes actual peer scans/footprints, then ACK. This confirms publish calls, not Nav2 costmap consumption.

Guard waits until its actual received bundle is exactly referenced and own local input is causal/fresh under original gates; after peer commit ref it computes exactly once at T. All sameclock new input callbacks may update caches but never trigger second normal commit.
Actual output local receipts complete original motion ACK. Worker then waits three exact actual driver target storage ACKs.
Evaluator actual-clock terminal phase completes before subsequent physical advance. All three receipt sets and epoch/clock remain unchanged when sending next physical request.
minimal_protocol.idempotency: Same request ID with exact same payload returns same cached ACK, no new sequence/publication/decision. Any conflicting payload, regressed clock/ID, stale/different epoch, future source, changed actual clock, or error ACK fails closed. No opportunistic timer retick or known-error cache bypass.
minimal_protocol.policy_snapshot: At sameclock snapshot, information map drain preserves real original map processing completion; state watermark refers to already committed bundle. It must not publish another bundle or change source stamps after guard commit. The actor/reward stay unchanged.

terminal_close.known_terminal_before_normal_commit: If evaluator terminal is known at uncommitted T, choose zero-only guard commit without needing fresh state; ready=false may remain. This is stop execution, not safe geometry credit.
terminal_close.late_terminal_after_normal_commit: Need explicit separate immutable emergency-stop class/ACK rather than changing original T normal ACK. Permanent halt accepts only exact zero outputs, increasing target sequence and sameclock actual storage, then zero-only cleanup quanta. Never resume policy or reclassify as normal ready.
terminal_close.rationale: Stopping cannot depend on the very fresh input whose loss triggered failure. All stop actions still require actual zero target storage before any cleanup physics. Retain true task/infrastructure failure and strict native shutdown outcomes.

unchanged: world raw body1.2/.30/7 and A/B response gates
must_version: state/peer/guard phase ledgers and exact ingress/commit references
stop-only ledger/normal immutability audit and driver phase interpretation
audit_compatibility.old_evidence: Old freezes, readers, failed receipts remain immutable. New readers dispatch only explicit new configuration; no reason-string-only relaxation or old logs relabeling.

candidate_interface: mr3_information.py causal explicit state commit and map-only drain reuse
safety_reward_audit: peer_obstacles.py controlled bundle+side binding and actual publication ACK
pure peer phase tests/independent phase consumer
runtime_stability: optional dedicated pure protocol helper/tests only after explicit owner assignment

limitations: This chain removes asynchronous selection/decision ordering, not arbitrary missing SLAM inputs: if newest causal TF remains older than .5s with physics paused, bounded wall wait must honestly fail.
Peer publication does not prove costmap/master/planner consumption; retain raw costmap provenance and state this limit.
Driver storage is not motor response: body/stop gates remain independent.
No predeclared budget increase assumed; actual full matrix runtime may rise substantially with sequential barriers.
